rebuilds a sample of entries without the cache and compares them

Usage: dolos cache verify [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --namespace <NAMESPACE>  the namespace to check, every one with a use if omitted
      --sample <SAMPLE>        entries rebuilt per namespace [default: 100]
      --format <FORMAT>        How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts [default:
                               text] [possible values: text, json]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>        
  -h, --help                   Print help
